summary: Prepare for the PECB ISO 50001 Lead Implementer exam and build practical EnMS implementation, monitoring, and improvement skills.
audienceIntro: This ISO 50001 Lead Implementer course is for professionals who plan, coordinate, or support an Energy Management System and its improvement. It suits people who need to translate energy-management requirements into organizational processes and maintain EnMS conformance.
prerequisites: PECB states that you need a fundamental understanding of ISO 50001 and comprehensive knowledge of implementation principles to attend this course.
